newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Caltex Philippines to shut 35,000-bpd CDU Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: Caltex Philippines to shut 35,000-bpd CDU Jan 20.

text.p: Caltex Philippines, a unit of the joint-venture between Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp will shut January 20 a 35,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) for at least eight days for checks, a company source said on Tuesday.
"We would like to inspect and carry out repairs to a portion of the column of the CDU," said the source.
He said the decision to shut down the CDU was made in December after there were suspicions of some damage.

Caltex will also take advantage of a fall in hydrogen production due to the CDU shutdown to carry out maintenance works on a 16,000-bpd naphtha hydrotreater and a 6,000-bpd platformer for a week and a half from January 20.
"The platformer's catalyst was due for regeneration," the source said.
A 14,000-bpd diesel desulphurisation unit will also be closed for maintenance then, but for two to three weeks.
Caltex also plans to bring down in February a 12,000-bpd catalytic cracker as originally planned in November but no further details were yet available.
The source said that the planned shutdowns would not disrupt supply.
There are no shutdown plans for the second CDU at Caltex' refinery in Batangas in the Philippines which usually runs at 65,000 to 75,000-bpd, the source said.
